derivation: from G3563 (νοῦς) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);
def: calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning

occurrences.text: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
